name: Ulbrik Mudcrown VII
source_profile:
King Ulbrik Mudcrown VII (CE)

Ulbrik is a vain, unpredictable, and frequently cruel bullywug monarch who claims descent from an uninterrupted line of swamp kings.

He regards travelers entering his marshes as subjects of his kingdom and demands extravagant displays of respect. Those who refuse may be imprisoned, robbed, or sentenced to absurd punishments.

Ulbrik is particularly fascinated by Cadorian noble customs and has begun imitating the titles, ceremonies, and heraldry of the southern aristocracy, often with grotesque results.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 55 (source excerpt; may be partial)
